toolsPreview.name: get_surf_forecast
toolsPreview.description: 7 day surf forecast (wave height in feet, wave period in seconds, wind speed in mph, wind direction in degrees) for the nearest coastal forecast point to a latitude/longitude. Data from NOAA wave models.

toolsPreview.name: get_surf_forecast_by_spot
toolsPreview.description: 7 day surf forecast for a named surf spot. Tries saved Global Surfari locations first, then geocodes the name. Example: "Bondi Beach", "Mavericks", "Bells Beach".

toolsPreview.name: list_surf_spots
toolsPreview.description: Lists surf spots saved by Global Surfari users (popular and recently added).
